subject: bridge/n2r consistent point (source + focused tests green); full gates queued behind cargo lease
body: Consistent now, all additive/gated: (1) pre-frame preload, default OFF (NORD2_METAL_PREFRAME / n2mb_preframe; frame_shader_dcds=0 -> byte-identical packets, asserted). (2) bridge batch accepts TILE_ATTACHMENT (only reachable with TEGU_TILE_FETCH_DEFAULT tile variants). (3) NEW per root: native indexed draws with vertex attributes. nord2_render_resources.inc no longer refuses index+attributes; follows pinned Mesa gallium v9 (pan_cmdstream.c 3388: arch>=9 does no min/max index scan; BUFFER.size = bound range bounds the fetch). n2r validates vertex 0 + full index span; PRIMITIVE index_type/count native, base_vertex_offset 0; baseVertex!=0 (opts WRITE_VERTEX_BASE with vertex_base!=0) REFUSED for indexed+attributes (vertex_id/base_vertex sysval contract with base_vertex_offset unverified) -> encoder keeps CPU expansion for those; encoder must pass the UNADJUSTED vertex base for indexed draws. Also indexed TRIANGLE_STRIP now sets PRIMITIVE.primitive_restart (Metal fixed all-ones restart; Mesa v9 fixed-index restart) - this changes bytes for existing indexed strip draws (semantic fix). Gates so far: iOS -Werror syntax bridge+render; render_semantics oracle (Mesa genxml unpack) PASS incl. new indexed + preframe sections; metal_bridge_test ASan PASS (preframe + tile batching blocks). Pending (lease busy: cargo test running, sensors 90C): run_host_tests, integration --candidate, render harness, CA test preframe 0/1. Hashes in next post after gates.
